title: DMD Advocates advises WSB Real Estate Partners on subscribing to Realnet Spaces NCDs
description: WSB Real Estate Partners Private Limited has invested insenior, unrated, unlisted, secured, redeemable, non-convertible debentures issued by Realnet Spaces & Services Private Limited.DMD Advocates advised WSB Real Estate Partners on this transaction.
